text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day Nishino Flower starts
training in
earnest for her debut in the
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite my lack of knowledge and
experience,
she accepted me as her
trainer. With her future in
my hands, I
know what I have to do.
choice_data_list_en: (Time to whip up a training menu right away!)
(Let's put together a training menu right away!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's work my fingers to the
bone—I'll simply
overcome my
shortcomings with effort. Just as I
feel
my resolve renewed...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer! Working hard as always, I
see!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Today, our journey together finally
begins, so I
wanted to come and greet
you properly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I, Nishino Flower, will put everything I
have into
this! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right! And... I know we don't start
training until
the afternoon, but...
choice_data_list_en: Same here, looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't had lunch yet, I thought
you might
be interested in trying this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yup, I made a bento box!
choice_data_list_en: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I made it especially for you...
So please
accept it!
choice_data_list_en: Can I really take this?
Can I have this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's bento box includes
rolled
omelettes, rice balls, a stewed
side dish, and a
bean salad, all arranged
appetizingly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...How does it taste?
choice_data_list_en: Thank you for the food!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yay! ♪
choice_data_list_en: It's super delicious!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You mean the butterbur and deep-fried
tofu? I
prepared them yesterday, so the
flavor had time
to really soak through! ♪
choice_data_list: この煮物、よく出汁がしみてるな
この煮物、よく出汁がしみてるね
choice_data_list_en: This simmered dish has soaked up the broth nicely, huh.
This simmered dish has soaked up the broth nicely, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Please tell me how you prefer your
food to be
seasoned. I'll do my best to
match your tastes
next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
As long as you don't mind. I love to
cook, but
more than anything...
choice_data_list: また作ってくれるのか？
choice_data_list_en: Will you make it for me again?
Will you make some for me again?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It makes me happy to see people smile
as they
eat the things I made for them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Nishino Flower and I eat lunch
together, we
jump right into her training.
choice_data_list_en: Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower zooms down the track.
Though
small in stature, I get a sense of
her innate talent
by how hard she runs.
Not to mention...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
choice_data_list_en: (What incredible speed...!)
(Incredible speed...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so? Thank you!
choice_data_list_en: You ran great!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're praising me too much... I'm still
a long
way from where I want to be!
choice_data_list: “飛び級”した実力は本物だな
“飛び級”した実力は本物だね
choice_data_list_en: The skills that let you 'skip ahead' are the real deal.
The skills that let you 'skip ahead' are the real deal, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower was granted early
admission to
Tracen Academy. That in
and of itself is an
amazing
accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the fact that she skipped a few
grades comes
with its own set of
concerns...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer, Nishino Flower.
Sorry to
interrupt your training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong, Tazuna?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Can you spare some time once your
session is
over? The infirmary doctor
would like to have a
word with you
about Nishino Flower's physique.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
As you are aware, Nishino Flower
enrolled at
Tracen Academy earlier than
most students.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The decision was based on both her
impressive
talent and the fact that she
was determined to be
entering her
race-ready stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being "race-ready" refers to an
Umamusume's
period of physical
development. It's during this
time that
their ability as an athlete grows

dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, Nishino Flower is already
more than
capable of competing in
races. However...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the other students, my
body still
has a lot of growing left to
do... Right?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. I believe this was already
discussed with
you and your parents
prior to your enrollment.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, her body is already in a state of
flux.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That's why I implore you to factor in her
physical
state when making decisions on
her training and
races. I trust you'll do
what you believe is best for
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is the age of an
elementary school
student. Naturally,
she doesn't compare
physically to the
others starting their racing
careers.
choice_data_list_en: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There may be times in the future where
that
leaves her at a disadvantage, but
for the time
being...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But it's fine for me to keep running,
right? I'll just
have to train hard to make
up for any physical
differences!

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's a great mindset to have. I'm
sure you'll
become a splendid
Umamusume. Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'll do my best. I promise!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I know it won't be easy, but I'll find a
way to rise
above any hardships!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work even harder than you
will!
choice_data_list_en: I'll do my best too!
I'll do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And, um, on that note... I still have
plenty of
energy left over, so can I do
some extra training?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay...
choice_data_list: 初日だし、今日はもう休もうか
choice_data_list_en: It's only the first day, so let's call it here and rest.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I understand. Are you going to take the
rest of
the day off, too?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Studying?
choice_data_list: ちょっと勉強していこうかな
choice_data_list_en: Maybe I'll study up on it a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While there's nothing keeping her from
starting
her career, Nishino Flower's
circumstances are
quite special and
require extra attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That means I need to continue learning
every day
so that I'm ready to tackle any
unforeseen
problems that might pop up.
After all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: 俺はまだまだ未熟だから
私はまだまだ未熟だから
choice_data_list_en: I still have a long way to go.
I still have so much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! Have a nice night!
choice_data_list_en: Well then, see you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer didn't sound all too confident...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Despite being so small and
inexperienced,
Trainer told me I'd do
fine and agreed to guide
me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(There's got to be a way for me to repay
such
kindness and help Trainer gain
some courage and
confidence.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But how do I do that?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry! I just got a little lost in my
thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(This is Grass Wonder. She's kind and
has a gentle
nature, and she's a fellow
member of the
groundskeeping
committee.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. Just let
me know if
there's anything you don't
understand about your
duties.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate that—thank you! I'll go
water the
flowers now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Wait a minute. This flower bed is
empty.
But there was moss phlox
growing here before.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it seems there are no plans to grow
anything
new in that flower bed for now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you have any ideas for how to use it,
please let
me know.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(A new flower bed... It sure would be
pretty if all
kinds of flowers were
blooming in it.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Hehe! Watching flowers try their
hardest to
bloom always gives me so
much courage.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps if I work really, really hard,
then...
